recommendation: Keep this fix as the final FHIR-22684 reconciliation. It completes the missing general-model content without restoring retired Consent.scope wording or duplicating the longer Scope and Usage section.
issue_request: FHIR-22684 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Consent and requested general-model fixes after query/search parameters changed, including a Kind/scope context parameter plus patient/third-party grantor, data, policy-domain location/authority, accountability, dates, actions, and actors.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly cited FHIR-22684. Untagged 2019 Consent commits bbe7cd28e and f42fe3d57 applied or preserved most requested bullets in source/consent/consent-notes.xml, but the Kind/scope bullet was not added.
additional_context: Later Consent decisions changed the correct current wording: FHIR-31903 removed Consent.scope and folded scope-like classification into optional Consent.category, while FHIR-47213 clarified that Consent.category identifies broad consent scope and can support multiple scopes. FHIR-31906 explains the adjacent grantee/controller accountability terminology.
reconciliation: Changed source/consent/consent-notes.xml to add a Kind bullet under Privacy Consent General Model: category identifies the broad scope of the Consent, for example privacy, treatment, or research.
source_changes: source/consent/consent-notes.xml: added a Kind context-setting bullet that maps the issue's scope concept to current Consent.category.

related_jiras.note: Removed Consent.scope and made Consent.category the current classification surface, constraining the FHIR-22684 fix to category wording.
Clarified that Consent.category identifies broad Consent scope and supports multiple consent types.
Explains adjacent current grantee/controller terminology replacing old performer wording.
